title: How Do Headphones Cancel Noise With More Noise?
description:
Noise-cancelling headphones don't block the engine roar. They add a second sound: its mirror image, so the two cancel at your ear.
Here is how that works, and why it tames the low drone of a plane but barely touches the voice next to you.
